theorem partial_closed (f : Bonding X) (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) (n : ℕ) :
    IsClosed (PartialCompatible f n)

theorem partial_decreasing (f : Bonding X) (n : ℕ) :
    PartialCompatible f (n + 1) ⊆ PartialCompatible f n
theorem partial_nonempty (f : Bonding X) (n : ℕ) : (PartialCompatible f n).Nonempty

theorem realization_exists (f : Bonding X) (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) :
    ∃ b, Compatible f b

theorem survivor_realized (f : Bonding X) (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i))
    (i : ℕ) (y : X i) (hy : Survives f i y) :
    ∃ b, Compatible f b ∧ b i = y

theorem survival_iff_projection (f : Bonding X) (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i))
    (i : ℕ) (y : X i) : Survives f i y ↔ ∃ b, Compatible f b ∧ b i = y

theorem survivor_exists (f : Bonding X) (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) (i : ℕ) :
    ∃ y : X i, Survives f i y

theorem all_singleton_iff_unique (f : Bonding X) (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) :
    AllSingleton f ↔ UniqueRealization f

@[simp] theorem transport_self (f : Bonding X) (i : ℕ) (x : X i) :
    transport f i i le_rfl x = x

theorem transport_succ (f : Bonding X) (i j : ℕ) (h : i ≤ j) (x : X (j + 1)) :
    transport f i (j + 1) (by omega) x = transport f i j h (f j x)

@[simp] theorem transport_one (f : Bonding X) (i : ℕ) (x : X (i + 1)) :
    transport f i (i + 1) (Nat.le_succ i) x = f i x

theorem transport_comp (f : Bonding X) (i j k : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (hjk : j ≤ k) (x : X k) :
    transport f i k (hij.trans hjk) x =
      transport f i j hij (transport f j k hjk x)

theorem transport_left (f : Bonding X) (i j : ℕ) (h : i + 1 ≤ j) (x : X j) :
    transport f i j (by omega) x = f i (transport f (i + 1) j h x)

theorem compatible_transport (f : Bonding X) (b : ∀ i, X i) (hb : Compatible f b)
    (i j : ℕ) (h : i ≤ j) : transport f i j h (b j) = b i

theorem compatible_survives (f : Bonding X) (b : ∀ i, X i) (hb : Compatible f b)
    (i : ℕ) : Survives f i (b i)

@[simp] theorem finitePath_at [∀ i, Nonempty (X i)] (f : Bonding X) (j : ℕ) (z : X j)
    (i : ℕ) (h : i ≤ j) : finitePath f j z i = transport f i j h z

theorem finitePath_compatible [∀ i, Nonempty (X i)] (f : Bonding X) (j : ℕ) (z : X j)
    (i : ℕ) (h : i < j) : finitePath f j z i = f i (finitePath f j z (i + 1))

theorem transport_continuous (f : Bonding X) (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i))
    (i j : ℕ) (h : i ≤ j) : Continuous (transport f i j h)

theorem coordinate_forgetting_iff_diameter (f : Bonding X) (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) :
    CoordinateForgetting f ↔ DiameterShrinking f

theorem nonuniform_four_way (f : Bonding X) (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) :
    (AllSingleton f ↔ UniqueRealization f) ∧
    (UniqueRealization f ↔ DiameterShrinking f) ∧
    (DiameterShrinking f ↔ HorizonForgetting f)

@[simp] theorem extensionRange_of_le (f : Bonding X) (i j : ℕ) (h : i ≤ j) :
    extensionRange f i j = Set.range (transport f i j h)

theorem range_step (f : Bonding X) (i j : ℕ) :
    extensionRange f i (j + 1) ⊆ extensionRange f i j
theorem ranges_antitone (f : Bonding X) (i : ℕ) : Antitone (extensionRange f i)

theorem extensionRange_closed (f : Bonding X) (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) (i j : ℕ) :
    IsClosed (extensionRange f i j)

theorem survival_iff_all_ranges (f : Bonding X) (i : ℕ) (x : X i) :
    Survives f i x ↔ ∀ j, x ∈ extensionRange f i j

theorem singleton_coordinate_attraction (f : Bonding X) (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i))
    (i : ℕ) (e : X i) (hs : ∀ x, Survives f i x ↔ x = e) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ j ≥ N, ∀ h : i ≤ j, ∀ z : X j,
      dist (transport f i j h z) e < ε

theorem all_singleton_attraction (f : Bonding X) (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i))
    (hs : AllSingleton f) : ∃ b, Compatible f b ∧ CoordinateAttraction f b

theorem attraction_implies_forgetting (f : Bonding X) (b : ∀ i, X i)
    (ha : CoordinateAttraction f b) : CoordinateForgetting f

theorem forgetting_implies_all_singleton (f : Bonding X) (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i))
    (hd : CoordinateForgetting f) : AllSingleton f

theorem coordinate_iff_horizon_forgetting (f : Bonding X) :
    CoordinateForgetting f ↔ HorizonForgetting f

theorem coordinate_iff_horizon_attraction (f : Bonding X) (b : ∀ i, X i) :
    CoordinateAttraction f b ↔ HorizonAttraction f b

theorem nonuniform_completion_equivalences (f : Bonding X) (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) :
    (AllSingleton f ↔ UniqueRealization f) ∧
    (AllSingleton f ↔ CoordinateForgetting f) ∧
    (CoordinateForgetting f ↔ HorizonForgetting f)

theorem unique_iff_horizon_attraction (f : Bonding X) (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) :
    UniqueRealization f ↔ ∃ b, Compatible f b ∧ HorizonAttraction f b
theorem constant_compatible (p : ∀ i, X i) : Compatible (constantBonds p) p
theorem constant_unique (p : ∀ i, X i) : UniqueRealization (constantBonds p)

theorem constant_survival (p : ∀ i, X i) (i : ℕ) (x : X i) :
    Survives (constantBonds p) i x ↔ x = p i
theorem moving_unique : UniqueRealization movingBonds
theorem moving_not_surjective : ¬ Function.Surjective (movingBonds 1)
theorem bitPath_compatible (c : Bool) : Compatible tailBits (bitPath c)

theorem first_coordinate_singleton :
    ∀ x : Bool, Survives tailBits 0 x ↔ x = false
theorem first_coordinate_does_not_give_unique : ¬ UniqueRealization tailBits

theorem empty_forgetting [∀ i, MetricSpace (X i)] [∀ i, IsEmpty (X i)]
    (f : Bonding X) : HorizonForgetting f

theorem empty_has_no_realization [IsEmpty (X 0)] (f : Bonding X) :
    ¬ UniqueRealization f
